input: analysis/round29/L4-image-forensics/ctrl.ps (synthetic: Helvetica text + blue rect). LP2 page-0 PS/PDF source is NOT in the repo, so this is the fallback form of item 3.
builds: ghostpdl tags ghostpdl-9.04 and ghostpdl-9.14 (GitHub archive), gs/ configure, gcc 15.2 with -std=gnu89 -fcommon -w -D_GNU_SOURCE + -Wno-error=implicit-*; 9.04 additionally -DHAVE_SYS_TIME_H; bin/gs --version = 9.04 / 9.14. 9.14 built in ~104 s (-j2); 9.04 needed several fix-and-resume attempts (~5 min total).

page_with_text_ctrl_ps.segment_diff: 9.14 has APP2 ICC_PROFILE (2576 B payload, md5 e409cef13cd06f6b371f6cddc8e31fcf = the LP2 profile); 9.04 has NO APP2; DQT/SOF identical; entropy-coded scan differs (glyph pixels)

page_without_text_nofont_ps.segment_diff: ONLY difference = APP2 ICC segment (2592 B) present in 9.14, absent in 9.04. DQT, SOF, all four DHT, SOS header and the 332138-byte entropy-coded scan are byte-identical.

verdict: O1 LIVE (not killed). 9.04 and 9.14 are byte-distinguishable at render level on the repo's own test PS; discriminator = ICC embedding (9.14 embeds the e409cef1 profile in jpeg-device output; 9.04 does not), plus text-glyph raster differences.
caveats: Helvetica font source/substitution not verified identical between the two trees (could explain the glyph diff)
built with gcc 15, not a 2011-14 toolchain; ICC embedding is gs source logic, but only two versions were built (9.05-9.13 untested, so the release where embedding starts is unknown)
LP2 evidence is the stage-2 file; IM is assumed to carry ICC through (R18-L1 chain control did)
